screens.description: Today overview, intake, burn, net calories, meal count, health flags, adherence score, and screening status.
Daily meal, hourly food logging, calorie totals, manual food entry, online calorie search, and food-photo estimate controls.
BMI, lipid profile, uric acid, fasting blood sugar, HbA1c, hemoglobin, diabetes status, blood pressure, mental wellness, and clinical insights.
Recommendation output with safety warnings, calorie/protein targets, Pakistani meal guidance, meal timing, grocery suggestions, workout sessions, and plan focus.
Profile inputs, goals, activity, diet pattern, training place, lifestyle modes, equipment, theme, and medical caution controls.

features: Pakistani calorie and protein plan generation
Pregnancy, blood pressure, kidney disease, diabetes medication, and PCOS safety gates
Daily, weekly, and monthly calorie intake/burn/net summaries
Manual food item and custom category entry
Desi food catalog with desserts, drinks, snacks, roti/rice, daal, sabzi, dairy, and proteins
Food photo preview estimator with local-only confidence label
Online calorie search URL generation with Pakistani context
Analysis dashboards, charts, bars, progress, trends, todos, and history
BMI and health marker reports for cholesterol, uric acid, blood sugar, HbA1c, hemoglobin, BP, and diabetes status
Mental wellness PHQ-9/GAD-7 screeners and Pakistan crisis resources
Local encrypted snapshot save, restore, and export preview
